keyFindings: Yes, I have just updated the `README.md` to be significantly more readable and accessible.
Prioritized "Why Photon?"**: Moved the core value proposition to the top in plain, non-technical language.
Simplified the "Highlights"**: Grouped technical features into clear, benefit-oriented points (e.g., "Local-First & Private").
Refined "Getting Started"**: Provided a 4-step path that makes it feel much less intimidating for a new user.
To make the `README.md` more accessible, I have focused on:
Simplifying the Tone**: Replacing technical jargon with clear, benefit-oriented language.
